dedupe_keys.name: epsis electric power statistics information system of the korea power exchange

description: EPSIS, the Electric Power Statistics Information System run by the Korea Power Exchange, is a web portal of Korean electricity statistics. Its menu, read on the day of cataloguing, covers power indicators with economic, national account and energy indicators and North Korean power indicators; generation capacity by fuel, plant type, member company and generating unit, with unit details; real-time supply and demand, supply and demand records, maximum and minimum load and monthly averages; fuel costs, system marginal price, market capacity, bids, traded volumes and amounts and settlement prices; transmission, substation and distribution facilities, including by region, communication facilities and trends in electrical faults by type; generation, fuel use, thermal efficiency, sales, losses and customer numbers; and nationally approved statistics. The site gives a KPX contact address for statistics queries and has an English version. Coverage is South Korea. Access is free on the web; no data licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: tables are presented through a web interface, so bulk use means exporting table by table. Simulation uses are Korean generation fleet, demand and network statistics for capacity expansion and market models, and fault trends for reliability studies. Related records: data-kpx-hourly-national-electricity-demand-korea is a KPX demand file on the Public Data Portal.
